eyebrow: Tag experiments, don't just commit them
code:
git add src/grover_toolkit/
git commit -m "Add resource estimate
  for 10-qubit Grover search"
git tag -a exp-grover-10q-2026-10-18
  -m "Resource estimate reported
  in docs/results.md section 4.2"
git push origin main --tags
caption: A convention like exp-<description>-<date> makes tags greppable — git show instantly retrieves the exact snapshot.

code:
# Standard
__pycache__/
.venv/

# Quantum-specific: raw result dumps
results/raw_counts/*.json

# Do NOT ignore: curated test fixtures
!tests/fixtures/expected_counts/*.json
caption: Raw experiment dumps don't belong in git — but small, curated "golden" files a regression test compares against absolutely do.
